title: What happens if you never change your phone password?

lines.text: When was the last time you actually changed your smartphone passcode?
lines.caps: When did you last | change your *passcode?

lines.text: Most people use the exact same four or six-digit PIN for years without thinking twice.
Over months of daily swiping, your finger oils leave subtle smudge trails on the glass.
lines.caps: Finger oils leave *smudge trails | across your *screen

lines.text: Under angled light or thermal cameras, anyone standing behind you can easily reconstruct your code.
lines.caps: Anyone behind you | can easily *see | your *code

lines.text: Even worse, automated brute-force cracking tools test common combinations in seconds.
Once someone has your device PIN, they can reset your Apple ID, passwords, and banking apps.
lines.caps: They can unlock | your *bank accounts | and *photos!

lines.text: Change your passcode to a strong six-digit mix today to keep your digital life safe.
